title: Default Boilerplate Browser Tab Title 'Create Next App' Exposed Live
defect: Defect & Root Cause: The root layout exports static metadata with title 'Create Next App'. Every live page on localhost:3000, /opportunities, /dashboard, and all shared links renders this default Next.js starter title in the browser tab, bookmark bar, and web search index previews, completely erasing product branding.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Update metadata in frontend/app/layout.tsx to use a template-driven title object: { default: 'CareerPilot AI — Autonomous Career Operating System', template: '%s | CareerPilot AI' }, along with a comprehensive product description and branding keywords.

title: Unconfigured Meta Description 'Generated by create next app'
defect: Defect & Root Cause: The root layout specifies description: 'Generated by create next app'. Search engine crawlers, social share cards (Twitter/LinkedIn/Slack), and screen reader summaries display this placeholder string, failing to communicate the platform's career intelligence capabilities.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Replace the description string with an authoritative summary: 'AI-orchestrated career intelligence platform combining autonomous agent workflows, deterministic validation, resume ATS parsing, and multi-source opportunity aggregation.'

title: Destructive Arial CSS Rule Overriding Custom Geist Sans Font Variable
defect: Defect & Root Cause: In frontend/app/globals.css line 25, body is hardcoded with 'font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;'. This completely overrides the Next.js font variable '--font-geist-sans' configured on the html element in layout.tsx, preventing the premium Geist font from ever rendering.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Remove the explicit Arial font-family declaration from globals.css. Allow Tailwind's 'font-sans' utility or the CSS variable 'var(--font-geist-sans)' defined in layout.tsx to cascade naturally across all HTML elements.

title: Hardcoded Universal CANDIDATE_ID 'api-user' Creating Data Contamination
defect: Defect & Root Cause: Line 20 of frontend/app/career-twin/page.tsx hardcodes 'const CANDIDATE_ID = "api-user";'. All concurrent users and browser sessions read and write to the exact same candidate profile, destroying user isolation, creating state race conditions, and exposing personal career information.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Remove the hardcoded constant. Derive candidate_id from a secure authenticated session token, an encrypted cookie, or a scoped persistent client identifier stored in secure storage.

title: Discrepant Timestamps in Request ID and Thread ID Initialization
defect: Defect & Root Cause: In frontend/app/page.tsx lines 205-212, requestId is constructed using Date.now(), and thread_id is constructed immediately afterward with a second Date.now() call. In high-resolution environments or multi-tick execution, requestId and thread_id diverge by milliseconds, breaking log aggregation, trace correlation, and checkpoint retrieval in backend agent memory.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Generate a single stable timestamp 'const now = Date.now();' or preferably use crypto.randomUUID() to initialize both request_id and thread_id: const traceId = crypto.randomUUID(); request_id: `req_${traceId}`, thread_id: `thread_${traceId}`.

title: Candidate ID Re-Instantiation on Every Execution Wiping Persistent Memory
defect: Defect & Root Cause: In frontend/app/page.tsx, the candidate_profile object passed to runAgenticWorkflow sets candidate_id to `frontend-${Date.now()}` on every single submit. The backend Career Twin and memory graph store each interaction under a completely new candidate entity, making iterative refinement and memory persistence impossible.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Persist candidate_id across sessions in a persistent browser cookie or localStorage. Only generate a fresh candidate_id if the user explicitly triggers 'New Profile' or clears workspace state.

title: Hardcoded Projects Array ['CareerPilot'] Injected into Candidate Profile
defect: Defect & Root Cause: In frontend/app/page.tsx lines 218-225, candidate_profile.projects is hardcoded to ['CareerPilot']. Regardless of what role, skill set, or background the candidate inputs, the agent reasoning engine evaluates them as having built 'CareerPilot', skewing job fit scoring and hallucinating domain experience.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Expose an interactive projects input field in the profile drawer/form. Split user-entered project strings into structured entities: projects.map(p => ({ title: p.trim() })). Default to an empty array when no projects are provided.

title: Fabricated Hardcoded Stat: '15' Opportunities Found
defect: Defect & Root Cause: Line 40 of frontend/app/dashboard/page.tsx renders static integer '15' for live matched opportunities. This number never queries the backend, never updates upon new searches, and misleads candidates regarding actual market availability.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Replace static value with dynamic query binding: const { data: stats } = useQuery(['dashboard-stats'], fetchDashboardMetrics); and render stats?.opportunity_count ?? '—' with an accessible loading skeleton.

title: Fabricated Hardcoded Stat: '6' Strong Matches (80+ Score)
defect: Defect & Root Cause: Line 54 of frontend/app/dashboard/page.tsx displays a hardcoded '6' for opportunities scoring 80+. If a user has 0 strong matches or 20, the dashboard permanently displays '6'.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Derive the metric from real opportunity search results: jobs.filter(j => (j.match_score ?? 0) >= 80).length, or pull aggregate statistics from the backend intelligence endpoint.

title: Fabricated Hardcoded Stat: '4' Skill Signals Tracked
defect: Defect & Root Cause: Line 68 of frontend/app/dashboard/page.tsx displays hardcoded '4' for skills represented in the profile, ignoring candidate profile updates, resume ATS extractions, and user skill additions.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Bind directly to the active Career Twin profile state: profile?.skills?.length ?? 0. Display an actionable prompt 'Add skills' when the count is zero.

title: Fabricated Hardcoded Stat: '0' Applications Active
defect: Defect & Root Cause: Line 82 of frontend/app/dashboard/page.tsx hardcodes '0' for applications. When a candidate clicks 'Apply' or tracks external submissions, the count remains permanently frozen at 0.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Integrate an applications store or database query: applications.filter(a => a.status !== 'ARCHIVED').length, allowing candidates to see their real-time application pipeline.

title: Static Hardcoded Event Logs Masquerading as Live Activity Feeds
defect: Defect & Root Cause: Lines 146-167 of frontend/app/dashboard/page.tsx render static cards claiming 'Live job intelligence connected: Adzuna and Jooble are currently feeding...' and 'Hybrid matching active'. These are static DOM elements that give false assurance of system operation even if backend providers fail.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Connect the recent activity feed to real provider health checkpoints via GET /agentic/health or /sources/status, displaying dynamic provider uptime and real ingestion timestamps.

title: Hardcoded 'active: true' Flag in Opportunities Navigation Data Array
defect: Defect & Root Cause: Lines 35-50 of frontend/app/opportunities/page.tsx declare a module-level navItems array with hardcoded active: true for Opportunities and false for others. When reused across layouts or during route navigation, active indicators fail to reflect the actual browser URL pathname.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Remove the static active property. In the navigation component, import usePathname from 'next/navigation' and dynamically compute: const isActive = pathname === item.href || pathname.startsWith(`${item.href}/`).

title: Hardcoded Default Skills Array ['Python', 'SQL', 'DSA', 'Git'] Forcing Unwanted Filters
defect: Defect & Root Cause: Lines 52-54 define const defaultSkills = ['Python', 'SQL', 'DSA', 'Git']. Every job search dispatched from this page injects these exact 4 skills into the request payload unless manually overridden, corrupting matches for frontend, design, product, or non-engineering roles.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Remove defaultSkills constant. Initialize search skills from the user's verified Career Twin profile or prompt the user with a multi-select tag input. Send an empty array or undefined if no skills are selected.

title: Hardcoded 'experience_years: 0' Silently Suppressing Senior Roles
defect: Defect & Root Cause: Line 915 of frontend/app/opportunities/page.tsx hardcodes experience_years: 0 in the payload sent to searchJobs(). Mid-level and senior candidates are continuously matched against entry-level criteria and junior roles, while senior positions are filtered out.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Add an explicit Experience Level input (number input or tiered dropdown: 0-2 yrs, 3-5 yrs, 5-8 yrs, 8+ yrs). Pass the validated integer in JobSearchRequest.experience_years.

title: Hardcoded 'preferred_work_modes: ["remote", "hybrid"]' Overriding On-Site Roles
defect: Defect & Root Cause: Line 920 of frontend/app/opportunities/page.tsx hardcodes preferred_work_modes: ['remote', 'hybrid']. Candidates seeking on-site opportunities in specific tech hubs (e.g. Bangalore, Hyderabad) are artificially excluded from on-site positions.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Add a multi-select chip toggle in the search form for [Remote, Hybrid, On-site]. Bind state directly to preferred_work_modes: selectedModes.length ? selectedModes : ['remote', 'hybrid', 'on-site'].

title: Hardcoded 'target_industries: ["technology"]' Excluding FinTech, HealthTech & EdTech
defect: Defect & Root Cause: Line 922 of frontend/app/opportunities/page.tsx forces target_industries: ['technology']. Domain-specific opportunities across Banking, Healthcare, Automotive, and E-commerce are filtered out or downgraded in match relevance.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Expose target industries selector with auto-complete chips. Allow candidates to search across multiple domains or leave open for cross-industry matching.

title: Unchecked job.apply_url Rendering Broken Self-Reloading Anchor Links
defect: Defect & Root Cause: Line 1733 of frontend/app/opportunities/page.tsx renders `<a href={job.apply_url} target='_blank'>`. When upstream job boards return an empty string or null for apply_url, clicking the primary 'Apply ↗' button navigates back to the current window, causing unexpected page reloads and state loss.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Conditionally render the link only if valid: {job.apply_url ? (Apply ↗) : ()}.

title: IntelligencePanel Primary Action Renders Broken Link on Missing apply_url
defect: Defect & Root Cause: In IntelligencePanel lines 830-845, the modal's primary 'Apply to this opportunity' CTA renders `<a href={job.apply_url}>` without null or URL protocol verification, leaving users stranded inside the modal on invalid links.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Implement URL validation utility isValidUrl(job.apply_url). If invalid or absent, fallback to displaying the employer website, recruiter contact, or an in-app tracking status.

title: Absence of AbortController and Timeout in searchJobs API Function
defect: Defect & Root Cause: In frontend/lib/api.ts lines 545-570, fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/jobs/search`, ...) executes with no AbortSignal or timeout. If the backend opportunity aggregation service experiences upstream delays with Jooble/Adzuna, the browser request hangs indefinitely with a frozen loading spinner.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Wrap fetch with AbortSignal.timeout(15000) or an explicit AbortController with cleanup: const controller = new AbortController(); const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 20000); pass signal: controller.signal.

title: Absence of AbortController and Timeout in runAgenticWorkflow
defect: Defect & Root Cause: In frontend/lib/agentic.ts lines 139-165, POST /agentic/run executes an unbounded multi-agent workflow that can execute for minutes. Without an AbortController, network dropped packets or backend deadlocks keep the UI in an un-cancellable blocking state.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Inject an optional signal parameter into runAgenticWorkflow(request, signal?: AbortSignal). Allow the frontend UI to display an explicit 'Cancel Run' button that triggers signal.abort().

title: Missing AbortController and Timeout in analyzeResume API
defect: Defect & Root Cause: In frontend/lib/api.ts lines 800-850, analyzeResume uploads a multipart FormData PDF payload with no client-side timeout. On slow cellular uplinks, the file upload silently stalls without error notification.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Attach an AbortController with an aggressive 30-second timeout. Catch AbortError specifically and display: 'Upload timed out. Please verify your connection or try a smaller PDF file.'

title: Inconsistent HTTP Cache Policies Between Resume and Search Endpoints
defect: Defect & Root Cause: While searchJobs specifies cache: 'no-store', analyzeResume and analyzeResumeForJob omit cache headers entirely. In Next.js client/server navigation, browser caches or proxy caches can return stale previous resume parse responses for newly uploaded files.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Enforce cache: 'no-store' and include 'Cache-Control': 'no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate' headers across all mutating and analysis fetch requests.

title: Corrupt Salary Status Fallback Marking Low Compensation as 'MEETS_TARGET'
defect: Defect & Root Cause: In frontend/lib/api.ts lines 740-755, normalize logic falls back to: salary_status: job.salary_status ?? (job.salary_disclosed ? 'MEETS_TARGET' : 'UNDISCLOSED'). If a job discloses a salary of 3 LPA when the user requested 15 LPA, this logic marks it as 'MEETS_TARGET', misleading candidates into applying for underpaying roles.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Compare disclosed salary against target: if (job.salary_disclosed) { const meets = targetSalary ? (job.salary_max ?? job.salary_min ?? 0) >= targetSalary : true; return meets ? 'MEETS_TARGET' : 'BELOW_TARGET'; } return 'UNDISCLOSED';

title: Unchecked evidence.relevance.toFixed(3) Triggering TypeError Crash
defect: Defect & Root Cause: In frontend/app/page.tsx line 748, the evidence card renders evidence.relevance.toFixed(3). If the backend returns a KnowledgeEvidence record with null or undefined relevance, calling .toFixed() throws an unhandled TypeError, crashing the entire React tree.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Safeguard numeric formatting: (typeof evidence.relevance === 'number' && !isNaN(evidence.relevance) ? evidence.relevance.toFixed(3) : '0.000').

title: Inverted getAgentState Logic Showing Spinning Loader on Completed Agents
defect: Defect & Root Cause: In frontend/app/page.tsx lines 120-135, getAgentState checks if result.agents_used.includes(agent) then returns 'done' only if status === 'COMPLETED'. During active execution, result is null so all agents show idle; after completion, intermediate active states were never shown, and failed workflows display confusing active loaders.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Track per-agent progress events via streaming or real-time trace updates: maintain an agentStatuses map updated as delegation traces arrive, displaying [IDLE, RUNNING, COMPLETED, FAILED] with accurate visual badges.

title: JobView Tab Type Defined but State Variable Missing, Rendering Flat Unnavigable DOM
defect: Defect & Root Cause: Line 55 of frontend/app/resume/page.tsx defines 'type JobView = "overview" | "requirements" | "rewrite" | "ai";', but no useState<JobView> exists in the component. The entire job match analysis renders as a single massive 3,000-line DOM document without tab filtering, overwhelming the user.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Instantiate const [jobView, setJobView] = useState<JobView>('overview'); and wrap the analysis views in accessible tab panels, rendering only the active section.

title: Unused expandedExperience State Variable Creating Non-Interactive Accordions
defect: Defect & Root Cause: Line 424 of frontend/app/resume/page.tsx declares const [expandedExperience, setExpandedExperience] = useState<number | null>(null);. It is cleared in resetAll(), but never toggled or bound to the resume experience list, leaving experience bullet points stuck in fixed-height truncated containers.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Bind expandedExperience to the experience cards: onClick={() => setExpandedExperience(expandedExperience === index ? null : index)}, expanding full bullet points, tech stacks, and quantifiable achievements.

title: File Input DOM Reference Value Not Cleared on Drop Validation Rejection
defect: Defect & Root Cause: When an invalid file (e.g. non-PDF or >10MB) is dropped onto the dropzone in resume/page.tsx, setSelectedFile(null) is called but fileInputRef.current.value is not cleared. Subsequent attempts to select the same file via the native file browser fail to fire the onChange event.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: In selectFile error branches, explicitly execute: if (fileInputRef.current) { fileInputRef.current.value = ''; } to ensure future file selections always trigger change events.

title: Premature searched=true State Update Displaying Misleading 'Live results' on Error
defect: Defect & Root Cause: In handleSearch (line 890), setSearched(true) is executed BEFORE searchJobs() resolves. If the network request fails with a 500 error or timeout, the UI header transitions to 'Opportunities for you / Live results' with an empty list instead of remaining in error state.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Move setSearched(true) into the try block immediately AFTER searchJobs succeeds: const res = await searchJobs(...); setJobs(res); setSearched(true);.

title: Abrupt IntelligencePanel Drawer Unmount on Search Triggering Data Loss
defect: Defect & Root Cause: When a candidate has IntelligencePanel open inspecting a job and submits a refined search query, setSelectedJob(null) is executed without warning, destroying review context, un-saved notes, and candidate focus.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Preserve selectedJob if the job still exists in the new result set, or display a confirmation banner: 'Searching will close your current job analysis. Proceed?'.

title: Live Homepage H1 Renders Grammatically Defective Text 'Your career,intelligently orchestrated.'
defect:
Defect & Root Cause: In frontend/app/page.tsx line 305, the main H1 reads 'Your career,
intelligently orchestrated.'. When rendered in plain text, screen readers, and Open Graph previews, it concatenates into 'Your career,intelligently orchestrated.' lacking a space after the comma.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Update to 'Your career, <br className="hidden sm:inline" />intelligently orchestrated.' ensuring proper typographic spacing across both formatted and unformatted text parsers.

title: Live Opportunities H2 Concatenates Without Space 'Search the market.Understand where you fit.'
defect:
Defect & Root Cause: In opportunities/page.tsx lines 1285-1290, H2 renders 'Search the market.
Understand where you fit.'. Plain text extractors and screen reader synthesis announce 'market.Understand' as a single run-on sentence without pause.
remediation:
Actionable Engineering Fix: Add an explicit space before or after the break: 'Search the market.
Understand where you fit.', or separate the lines into discrete semantic elements: `Search the market.Understand where you fit.`.

title: Total Absence of Navigation Sidebar and App Header in Dashboard Page
defect: Defect & Root Cause: frontend/app/dashboard/page.tsx renders a bare `<main>` container with zero navigation links, no sidebar, no breadcrumbs, and no logo. A user landing on /dashboard is trapped on the page with no way to navigate to /opportunities, /resume, or /career-twin without manually modifying the URL.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Wrap DashboardPage in the shared AppShell / Sidebar layout component, ensuring consistent desktop navigation, mobile drawer menu, and global header controls.

title: Raw `<a href>` Anchors Used for Internal Routes Forcing Hard Browser Reloads
defect: Defect & Root Cause: In dashboard/page.tsx lines 109 and 130, internal routes to /opportunities and /career-twin are wrapped in plain HTML `<a href>` tags instead of Next.js `<Link>`. Clicking them destroys client-side React state, triggers full HTML document re-fetches, and degrades performance.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Replace with Next.js Link: import Link from 'next/link'; `<Link href='/opportunities' className='...'>Open opportunities</Link>`.

title: Unauthenticated Public Endpoint Access to Sensitive Career Twin Profile
defect: Defect & Root Cause: In career-twin/page.tsx lines 138-150, fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/career-twin/${CANDIDATE_ID}`) executes with zero Authorization bearer headers, cookies, or cryptographic signatures. Any internet user can scrape, harvest, or tamper with candidate career data.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Attach an Authorization header with JWT / session token: headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${userSessionToken}` }. Return 401 redirect to login if session is absent.

title: Mobile Navigation Sidebar Lacks Escape Key Handler Creating Keyboard Trap
defect: Defect & Root Cause: In opportunities/page.tsx lines 1025-1045, the mobile sidebar overlay toggles on sidebarOpen state. However, there is no window keydown listener listening for 'Escape', creating a WCAG 2.1.2 keyboard trap for motor-impaired and assistive device users.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Add an Escape key event listener: useEffect(() => { const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => { if (e.key === 'Escape') setSidebarOpen(false); }; if (sidebarOpen) window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown); return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown); }, [sidebarOpen]);.

title: IntelligencePanel Modal Drawer Cannot Be Closed via Keyboard Escape Key
defect: Defect & Root Cause: In IntelligencePanel lines 380-410, the full-screen slide-over drawer only closes when the close button or backdrop is clicked. Pressing 'Escape' does nothing, violating universal modal interaction guidelines.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Add useEffect keydown listener inside IntelligencePanel that calls onClose() when event.key === 'Escape'.

title: IntelligencePanel Focus Not Trapped Allowing Tab Navigation into Obscured DOM
defect: Defect & Root Cause: When IntelligencePanel is opened, keyboard focus remains in the underlying opportunities list. Pressing Tab cycles through obscured buttons, inputs, and links behind the backdrop, violating WCAG 2.4.3 Focus Order.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Implement a focus trap using `@radix-ui/react-dialog` or an explicit focus trapping hook that restricts Tab / Shift+Tab cycling exclusively within the panel DOM.

title: Inability to Clear Results or Reset Session Without Full Page Refresh
defect: Defect & Root Cause: Once runAgenticWorkflow completes and renders results in frontend/app/page.tsx, there is zero 'Start New Goal' or 'Clear Results' action. Candidates wishing to analyze another goal must refresh the entire browser window, losing their candidate profile inputs.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Add a 'Reset Workspace' button in the results header that resets result state to null, clears errors, and refocuses the goal textarea without wiping the candidate profile fields.

title: Stale Error Banner Persisting Indefinitely While Candidate Edits Form
defect: Defect & Root Cause: In page.tsx, if an error occurs (e.g. backend offline), error state is set. When the user subsequently modifies their goal, role, or skills, the red error banner remains pinned to the screen, causing user confusion.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Clear error state on user input: onChange={(e) => { setUserGoal(e.target.value); if (error) setError(null); }} across all form fields.

title: User Goal Textarea Lacks maxLength Constraint Allowing Unbounded Payload Injection
defect: Defect & Root Cause: The goal textarea in page.tsx line 380 has no maxLength or character count limiter. A malicious or automated user can paste megabytes of text, causing client memory degradation and payload-too-large HTTP 413 exceptions on the FastAPI backend.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Add maxLength={2000} to the textarea. Display a live character counter: `{userGoal.length}/2000` and enforce validation prior to network dispatch.

title: Fragile Comma-Separated Skills Parser Producing Empty and Corrupt Skill Arrays
defect: Defect & Root Cause: In page.tsx line 214, skills are parsed via candidateSkills.split(',').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean). Consecutive commas (e.g. 'Python,,React') or trailing spaces can create malformed skill queries, while skills containing internal commas or periods fail to parse properly.
remediation:
Actionable Engineering Fix: Sanitize and de-duplicate input: Array.from(new Set(candidateSkills.split(/[,;
]+/).map(s => s.trim().replace(/^[^a-zA-Z0-9#+.]+|[^a-zA-Z0-9#+.]+$/g, '')).filter(Boolean))).

title: Home Page Workflow Form Lacks `<form>` Element Bypassing Enter Key Submission
defect: Defect & Root Cause: The input fields in page.tsx lines 350-480 are wrapped in standard `<div>` containers with an onClick handler on the 'Run CareerPilot' button. Pressing Enter while typing in the role, skills, or location inputs does not submit the workflow, violating universal web form usability.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Wrap the inputs in a semantic `<form onSubmit={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); handleRunCareerPilot(); }}>` and ensure the submit button has type='submit'.

title: Form Labels Lack htmlFor Attribute Breaking Click-to-Focus Functionality
defect: Defect & Root Cause: The form labels in page.tsx lines 400-470 (e.g. 'Target role', 'Skills', 'Location') are plain `<div>` or `<label>` elements missing the htmlFor attribute, and inputs lack corresponding id attributes. Clicking a label does not focus the input field.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Assign unique IDs to all inputs: id='candidate-role', id='candidate-skills', id='candidate-location', and pair with `<label htmlFor='candidate-role'>`.

title: Header Moon Theme Toggle Button Has Zero onClick Handler
defect: Defect & Root Cause: In opportunities/page.tsx lines 1225-1232, a theme toggle button rendering the Lucide Moon icon is displayed with aria-label='Toggle theme'. The button contains no onClick event listener and performs zero function when clicked by users.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Either integrate a functional theme provider (e.g. `next-themes` with useTheme toggle) or remove the dead button until multi-theme support is implemented.

title: Header CircleUserRound Profile Button Has Zero Action or Menu Binding
defect: Defect & Root Cause: In opportunities/page.tsx lines 1235-1242, a user profile button with the CircleUserRound icon renders with hover effects but no onClick handler. Users clicking their profile avatar to view account details or logout experience no response.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Bind the button to a dropdown menu displaying user profile info, settings link, and logout action, or link directly to /settings.

title: Sidebar User Profile Card Renders ChevronDown Implying Nonexistent Dropdown
defect: Defect & Root Cause: Line 1150 of opportunities/page.tsx displays a ChevronDown icon inside the sidebar profile card. The chevron communicates an expandable menu affordance, but clicking the card does nothing, frustrating users.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Implement an expandable profile drawer or popover menu when clicked, or remove the ChevronDown icon if the card is non-interactive.

title: LayoutDashboard Icon Semantically Misused as Mobile Hamburger Menu Trigger
defect: Defect & Root Cause: Line 1210 of opportunities/page.tsx renders the LayoutDashboard icon for the mobile navigation toggle button. Users universally recognize the three-bar Menu icon as the navigation trigger; using a dashboard icon misleads users into thinking it navigates to /dashboard.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Replace LayoutDashboard with `<Menu size={20} />` when closed and `<X size={20} />` when sidebarOpen is true.

title: Career Twin Memory Events Hard-Capped at 8 Without Pagination or Full View
defect: Defect & Root Cause: Line 493 of career-twin/page.tsx slices memory events with .slice(0, 8). If a candidate has a rich history of profile updates, job applications, and skill evaluations, all events beyond the 8th are permanently hidden from view with no 'Load More' or pagination controls.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Implement pagination or a 'View All Memory Events' accordion button: const [visibleCount, setVisibleCount] = useState(8); and render a button to increment visibleCount by 8 until all events are displayed.

title: Stats Section Declares 5 Columns on XL Screens with Only 4 Rendered Cards
defect: Defect & Root Cause: Line 1370 of opportunities/page.tsx styles the stats container with 'xl:grid-cols-5'. However, only 4 cards exist: Opportunities found, Salary verified, Salary undisclosed, and Job sources. On screens >= 1280px, the 5th column renders as a broken empty space.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Change the grid configuration to 'xl:grid-cols-4', or add a meaningful 5th metric card such as 'Average Match Score' or 'Top Skill Demand'.

title: Index Signature [key: string]: unknown on ResumeIntelligenceResponse Bypassing Type Safety
defect: Defect & Root Cause: In frontend/lib/api.ts lines 220-240, ResumeIntelligenceResponse includes [key: string]: unknown. This index signature allows typos in property names to pass TypeScript compilation silently, degrading type checking across all resume consumption modules.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Remove the index signature and explicitly type all known fields returned by the backend FastAPI schema. If dynamic fields exist, place them in a dedicated 'metadata?: Record<string, unknown>' property.

title: Index Signature [key: string]: unknown on ATSAnalysisResponse Eliminating Autocomplete
defect: Defect & Root Cause: In frontend/lib/api.ts lines 310-335, ATSAnalysisResponse specifies [key: string]: unknown. Developers and components accessing ats_score, missing_keywords, or category_scores receive no IDE autocomplete or compile-time guarantees.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Fully type the ATS schema with explicit interfaces for KeywordAnalysis, FormatChecks, and SectionEvaluations, removing the open index signature.

title: Union Type LLMValidationStatus Degraded by Appended `| string`
defect: Defect & Root Cause: In frontend/lib/api.ts line 185, export type LLMValidationStatus = 'PENDING' | 'ACCEPTED' | 'REJECTED' | string;. Appending `| string` widens the union type to any arbitrary string, completely defeating strict TypeScript discrimination in switch statements and comparisons.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Remove `| string`: export type LLMValidationStatus = 'PENDING' | 'ACCEPTED' | 'REJECTED' | 'FAILED';.

title: Union Type RewriteEvidenceStatus Degraded by Appended `| string`
defect: Defect & Root Cause: In frontend/lib/api.ts line 190, export type RewriteEvidenceStatus = 'SUPPORTED' | 'PARTIAL' | 'UNSUPPORTED' | string;. Widening to string prevents the compiler from warning if backend statuses change or typos occur.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Remove `| string`: export type RewriteEvidenceStatus = 'SUPPORTED' | 'PARTIAL' | 'UNSUPPORTED';

title: Untyped skill_gaps: unknown[] Array in AgenticRunResponse
defect: Defect & Root Cause: Line 62 of frontend/lib/agentic.ts types skill_gaps as unknown[]. Any component rendering skill gaps must use risky type assertions (gap as string), leading to runtime rendering errors if objects are returned.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Type skill_gaps as: skill_gaps: Array<string | { skill: string; importance: string; learning_resource?: string }>.

title: Untyped rewrite_candidates: unknown[] in AgenticRunResponse
defect: Defect & Root Cause: Line 56 of frontend/lib/agentic.ts types rewrite_candidates as unknown[]. The UI cannot safely render candidate bullet points or before/after diffs without risking runtime exceptions.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Define interface RewriteCandidate { bullet_id: string; original_text: string; suggested_text: string; reasoning: string; impact_score: number; } and type rewrite_candidates: RewriteCandidate[].

title: Untyped errors: unknown[] Array in AgenticRunResponse
defect: Defect & Root Cause: Line 76 of frontend/lib/agentic.ts defines errors: unknown[]. In the event of workflow partial failure, components cannot inspect error codes, error messages, or affected agent names safely.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Type errors as: errors: Array<{ agent: string; error_code: string; message: string; timestamp: string }>.

title: Untyped recommendations: Array<Record<string, unknown>> Requiring Unsafe Accessors
defect: Defect & Root Cause: Line 66 of frontend/lib/agentic.ts specifies recommendations: Array<Record<string, unknown>>. In page.tsx lines 180-195, helper functions getRecommendationTitle and getRecommendationAction must perform defensive type narrowing on every access.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Define a dedicated Recommendation interface: export interface Recommendation { id?: string; title: string; action: string; priority: 'HIGH' | 'MEDIUM' | 'LOW'; rationale?: string; category?: string; } and type recommendations: Recommendation[].

title: Untyped next_action: Record<string, unknown> Bypassing Action Verification
defect: Defect & Root Cause: Line 68 of frontend/lib/agentic.ts types next_action as Record<string, unknown>. In page.tsx line 780, rendering next_action.title or next_action.description lacks compile-time safety.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Define interface NextAction { title: string; description: string; action_type: 'APPLY' | 'UPSKILL' | 'REWRITE_RESUME' | 'EXPLORE'; target_url?: string; deadline?: string; }.

title: Untyped final_validation: Record<string, unknown> Preventing Structured Error Parsing
defect: Defect & Root Cause: Line 70 of frontend/lib/agentic.ts types final_validation as Record<string, unknown>. The frontend cannot reliably inspect validation checks, gate statuses, or policy violation arrays.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Define interface FinalValidation { valid: boolean; score: number; checks_passed: string[]; checks_failed: string[]; summary: string; }.

title: Unsanitized API Error Detail Strings Injected Directly into React State
defect: Defect & Root Cause: In api.ts parseError helper, raw errorData.detail strings from FastAPI exceptions are returned directly and passed to setError(). If an upstream service or database throws a raw stack trace, SQL error, or HTML error page, internal system details are leaked to users.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Sanitize and map technical errors to friendly user-facing messages. Log technical details only to console.error or monitoring tools.

title: Next.js Completely Missing Security Headers (CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options)
defect: Defect & Root Cause: frontend/next.config.ts exports an empty configuration object. The application serves no Content-Security-Policy, no Strict-Transport-Security, no X-Frame-Options, and no Referrer-Policy, leaving it vulnerable to clickjacking, MITM attacks, and script injection.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Configure async headers() in next.config.ts returning security headers including Content-Security-Policy, X-Frame-Options: DENY, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, and Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin.

title: Next.js Default Server Header Leaking 'X-Powered-By: Next.js'
defect: Defect & Root Cause: With an empty next.config.ts, Next.js attaches the 'X-Powered-By: Next.js' header to all HTTP responses, broadcasting the framework and facilitating targeted vulnerability probing by attackers.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Add poweredByHeader: false to next.config.ts.

title: Non-Standard LayoutProps<'/'> Type Relying on Ambient Declarations
defect: Defect & Root Cause: In layout.tsx line 19, export default function RootLayout({ children }: LayoutProps<'/'>) relies on an implicit global ambient type. It produces compiler warnings in strict environments and fails if Next.js ambient types are not regenerated.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Import standard ReactNode: import type { ReactNode } from 'react'; export default function RootLayout({ children }: { children: ReactNode }).

title: Defined CSS Theme Variables (--background, --foreground) Completely Inactive
defect: Defect & Root Cause: globals.css lines 6-20 declare :root and dark mode variables --background and --foreground. However, every page hardcodes bg-[#080a0f] and arbitrary text-white opacity classes, leaving the core theme tokens dead and preventing dynamic theme adjustments.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Bind the global background and text colors to the CSS variables: body { background-color: var(--background); color: var(--foreground); } and update page wrappers to use bg-background and text-foreground.

title: prefers-color-scheme: dark Media Query Overridden by Forced Dark Palette
defect: Defect & Root Cause: globals.css specifies a prefers-color-scheme: dark block, implying support for system color preferences. Yet all components render hardcoded dark styles, giving light-mode users no alternative while retaining dead media query code.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Implement class-based theme switching via `next-themes` (<html className='dark'>) and configure Tailwind color variables that respond dynamically.

title: Generic Package Name 'frontend' in package.json
defect: Defect & Root Cause: Line 2 of package.json specifies 'name': 'frontend'. In monorepo setups, container builds, and CI pipelines, generic names cause namespace collisions and lack identity.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Rename to 'name': 'careerpilot-ai-frontend' with a descriptive version and description field.

title: Broken Lint Script 'eslint' Missing Target Path Argument
defect: Defect & Root Cause: In package.json line 7, the lint script is 'lint': 'eslint'. In ESLint v9 flat config mode, executing `npm run lint` without a target directory lints nothing or throws command syntax errors.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Update to 'lint': 'next lint' or 'eslint . --max-warnings 0'.

title: Phantom Transitive Dependencies zod and zod-validation-error Missing from Manifest
defect: Defect & Root Cause: Zod packages exist in node_modules through transitive dependencies but are not declared in package.json. If a clean install or pnpm isolation is executed, schema parsing imports fail with ModuleNotFoundError.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Explicitly install dependencies: npm install zod zod-validation-error --save.

title: Unpinned lucide-react ^1.34.0 Leading to Breaking Icon Changes
defect: Defect & Root Cause: package.json declares 'lucide-react': '^1.34.0'. Caret dependencies on fast-moving icon libraries risk automated minor/patch upgrades breaking icon names or SVG props.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Pin to a verified stable release (e.g. 'lucide-react': '1.34.0' or '~1.34.0') with a verified package-lock.json.

title: Missing engines Field in package.json to Enforce Node Version Compatibility
defect: Defect & Root Cause: package.json lacks an engines field. Next.js 16 requires Node.js >= 18.18.0 or >= 20.9.0. Developers or deployment runners running older Node versions encounter cryptic build failures.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Add: "engines": { "node": ">=20.9.0", "npm": ">=10.0.0" } to package.json.

title: Complete Absence of Test Script in package.json
defect: Defect & Root Cause: package.json contains no 'test' script. There is no automated test runner configured, making regression testing impossible before production deployments.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Add Vitest or Jest: "test": "vitest run", "test:watch": "vitest".

title: Missing typecheck Script to Verify Compilation Without Build Overhead
defect: Defect & Root Cause: There is no script to run TypeScript compiler verification without triggering a full Next.js static build. Developers commit type errors that are only caught late in deployment.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Add: "typecheck": "tsc --noEmit" to package.json scripts.

title: Client Component Directive 'use client' on Root Page Destroying SSR Benefits
defect: Defect & Root Cause: Line 1 of frontend/app/page.tsx places 'use client' at the top of the 1,050-line file. The entire homepage renders as an empty client-side shell on initial load, inflating initial JavaScript payload and harming Largest Contentful Paint (LCP).
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Refactor page.tsx into a Server Component. Extract the interactive workflow form into `<WorkflowForm />` and results display into `<WorkflowResults />` as client components, while rendering the hero, branding, and feature cards server-side.

title: Entire 1,775-Line Opportunities Page Marked as Monolithic Client Component
defect: Defect & Root Cause: frontend/app/opportunities/page.tsx is a single 1,775-line client component. The desktop sidebar, hero banners, and static instructions ship to the client as JavaScript bundles instead of lean HTML.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Split into Server Shell (AppShell, Navigation, Static Hero) and Client Leaf components (SearchForm, OpportunitiesGrid, IntelligenceDrawer).

title: Massive 4,329-Line Resume Page Shipped as Single Client Bundle
defect: Defect & Root Cause: At 4,329 lines, resume/page.tsx is an enormous client-side bundle containing file parsers, UI score logic, tab renderers, and rewrite diffs. It causes substantial browser main-thread parsing delay on low-end devices.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Decompose into modular subcomponents: `<ResumeUpload />`, `<ResumeScores />`, `<ATSChecklist />`, `<JobMatcher />`, and `<RewriteSuggestions />`. Use dynamic imports with SSR disabled for heavy sub-panels.

title: Triplicate Redundant Declarations of API_BASE_URL Across Frontend Codebase
defect: Defect & Root Cause: const API_BASE_URL = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL || 'http://127.0.0.1:8000'; is declared independently in api.ts line 1, agentic.ts line 1, and career-twin/page.tsx line 16. Inconsistent fallbacks or refactors will cause subtle environment desynchronization.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Create frontend/lib/config.ts exporting a single validated API_BASE_URL constant and import it across all services.

title: Fragile UI String Comparison const hasSalary = sourceSalary !== 'Salary not disclosed'
defect: Defect & Root Cause: In SourceCard line 348, business logic checks `const hasSalary = sourceSalary !== 'Salary not disclosed'`. If the formatting function updates wording (e.g. to 'Undisclosed' or localized strings), this boolean silently flips, corrupting salary rendering.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Check raw numeric data properties directly on the source record: const hasSalary = typeof source.salary_min === 'number' || typeof source.salary_max === 'number' || Boolean(source.salary_raw);.

title: Identical Multi-Sentence Undisclosed Salary Paragraph Repeated on Every Card
defect: Defect & Root Cause: Lines 1622-1627 of opportunities/page.tsx render a 3-line paragraph on every single job card where salary is undisclosed: 'The company has not disclosed compensation. Contact the employer or recruiter directly to confirm the expected salary range.'. In a list of 20 jobs, this identical paragraph repeats 15+ times, bloating vertical scroll.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Condense to a single compact badge: ` Compensation undisclosed` with an optional tooltip on hover.

title: Salary Input Regex Permitting Multiple Decimal Points (e.g. '6.5.5')
defect: Defect & Root Cause: In opportunities/page.tsx line 1335, the salary input cleans input with event.target.value.replace(/[^0-9.]/g, ''). This permits candidates to enter '6.5.5', resulting in NaN upon Number() conversion and triggering an error state.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Enforce strict single-decimal formatting: val.replace(/[^0-9.]/g, '').replace(/(\..*?)\..*/g, '$1').

title: Undocumented 10MB Client-Side File Upload Limit with No Backend Enforcement
defect: Defect & Root Cause: In resume/page.tsx line 475, maximumSize = 10 * 1024 * 1024 checks file size in the browser. If an attacker uses curl or an API tool directly, the backend lacks explicit file size limits, risking memory exhaustion or denial of service.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Coordinate client validation with backend FastAPI middleware enforcing Content-Length <= 10MB, returning 413 Payload Too Large if exceeded.

title: Silent Error Suppression in parseError Helper Returning Generic Fallbacks
defect: Defect & Root Cause: In agentic.ts lines 87-112, parseError catches all JSON parsing failures with an empty catch block `catch {}` and falls back to a generic message. If the backend returns HTML error pages (e.g. Nginx 502 Bad Gateway), the actual error cause is swallowed.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: In catch block, extract response.statusText or raw response.text() slice to provide actionable diagnostics: `return `${fallback}: ${response.status} ${response.statusText}`;`.

title: Stale Memoization Dependency on result?.delegation_trace in getLatestDelegation
defect: Defect & Root Cause: In page.tsx line 140, useMemo derives latest delegation with dependency [result?.delegation_trace]. When result updates with new metadata or errors without reallocating delegation_trace, the memoized value becomes stale.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Update dependency array to [result] or [result?.delegation_trace, result?.status].

title: Array Index Used as React Key in Recommendations Map
defect: Defect & Root Cause: In page.tsx line 790, recommendations are mapped with key={index}. When recommendations reorder or new recommendations are prepended by agents, React's virtual DOM reconciliation malfunctions, causing visual glitches and focus loss.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Use stable composite keys: key={rec.id ?? `rec-${rec.title}-${index}`}.

title: Array Index Used as React Key in ResultSkeleton Component
defect: Defect & Root Cause: In ResultSkeleton line 210, skeleton items are mapped using key={index}. While acceptable for static skeletons, it violates ESLint react/no-array-index-key rules and sets bad codebase patterns.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Use explicit static keys: key={`skeleton-${index}`}.

title: Array Index Used as React Key in SourceCard Map
defect: Defect & Root Cause: In opportunities/page.tsx lines 330-360, source records are rendered with key={index}. If source records are re-sorted by salary or confidence, DOM state is incorrectly retained.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Use unique source identifiers: key={`${source.source}-${source.source_job_id ?? index}`}.

title: Recommendation Index Badge Container Overflows on Double-Digit Counts
defect: Defect & Root Cause: In page.tsx line 805, the numbered recommendation index is styled with a fixed-width container 'h-6 w-6 text-xs'. When recommendations reach 10+, the double-digit text overflows the container edges, creating visual distortion.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Change container to min-w-[1.5rem] px-1 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center.

title: Unchecked result.retry_count Renders Literal 'undefined' in Sidebar Stats
defect: Defect & Root Cause: In page.tsx line 850, `{result.retry_count}` is rendered directly in the sidebar stat grid. When backend responses omit retry_count or return null, the browser displays literal text 'undefined'.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Provide default: `{result.retry_count ?? 0}`.

title: Unchecked result.tools_used.length Throws TypeError When tools_used is Undefined
defect: Defect & Root Cause: In page.tsx line 865, the tools counter executes `{result.tools_used.length}`. If an incomplete agentic response is returned where tools_used is omitted, accessing .length throws an unhandled TypeError.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Use optional chaining with nullish coalescing: `{result.tools_used?.length ?? 0}`.

title: Unvalidated readiness_score Injecting 'NaN%' into Progress Bar Inline Style
defect: Defect & Root Cause: In page.tsx line 880, the readiness progress bar sets style={{ width: `${result.candidate_intelligence?.readiness_score}%` }}. If readiness_score is null, undefined, or a non-numeric string, width evaluates to 'NaN%' or 'undefined%', failing CSS parsing.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Sanitize score: const score = typeof result?.candidate_intelligence?.readiness_score === 'number' ? Math.max(0, Math.min(100, result.candidate_intelligence.readiness_score)) : 0; style={{ width: `${score}%` }}.

title: Raw Uppercase Backend Enums 'COMPLETED', 'FAILED' Exposed Directly to Users
defect: Defect & Root Cause: In page.tsx lines 510-530, the header status badge prints raw API strings like 'COMPLETED' or 'FAILED' in harsh all-caps, reading like internal database dump codes rather than user-facing software.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Create a mapping utility: const STATUS_MAP = { COMPLETED: 'Analysis Complete', FAILED: 'Workflow Failed', RUNNING: 'In Progress', READY: 'System Ready' };.

title: Header Status Badge Missing Loading State During Active Workflow Execution
defect: Defect & Root Cause: When runCareerPilot is executing, the status badge in the header continues displaying 'READY' or the previous run's 'COMPLETED' until the entire multi-second request finishes, giving conflicting visual feedback.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: When loading is true, display: ` Orchestrating agents...`.

title: Rigid Boolean Checks result.status === 'COMPLETED' Ignoring Partial States
defect: Defect & Root Cause: In page.tsx lines 600-620, result display gates strictly on status === 'COMPLETED' || status === 'FAILED'. If the backend returns 'PARTIAL_SUCCESS' or 'VALIDATION_WARNING', the entire result view is suppressed.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Refactor workflow state to handle granular lifecycle states: 'PENDING' | 'DISPATCHED' | 'AGENT_EXECUTION' | 'VALIDATING' | 'COMPLETED' | 'PARTIAL' | 'FAILED'.

title: Unnecessary Ellipsis Appended to Exact 360-Character Knowledge Evidence Strings
defect: Defect & Root Cause: In getEvidencePreview (line 165), text is sliced with text.slice(0, 360).trim() + '…'. If text is exactly 360 characters or shorter, an ellipsis is still forcibly appended, corrupting clean sentence endings.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Check length before appending: return text.length > 360 ? `${text.slice(0, 360).trim()}…` : text;.

title: Zero Empty State Handling When delegation_trace Array is Empty
defect: Defect & Root Cause: In page.tsx line 710, the Agent Delegation Trace section renders `<div className='space-y-2'>` mapping result.delegation_trace. If a cached workflow or direct response has no delegations, the section renders an awkward blank gray box.
remediation:
Actionable Engineering Fix: Render an informative empty state: `

Direct execution completed with no inter-agent delegations.

`.

title: Mobile Viewport Fails to Auto-Scroll to Results Upon Workflow Completion
defect: Defect & Root Cause: On mobile devices, the workflow form takes up 100% of the viewport height. When execution finishes, results appear below the fold without scrolling, leaving users looking at the completed button with no indication that results are ready below.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Add an auto-scroll ref: const resultsRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null); useEffect(() => { if (result && resultsRef.current) { resultsRef.current.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' }); } }, [result]);.

title: Job Avatar Initial Generator Returns Empty String on Empty Company Name
defect: Defect & Root Cause: In opportunities/page.tsx line 1526, job.company.slice(0, 2).toUpperCase() generates the avatar. If a job listing has an empty string for company, it renders an empty 48x48 box with no visual fallback.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Use safe fallback: (job.company?.trim().slice(0, 2) || 'CP').toUpperCase().

title: Join on Location Array with Empty Strings Producing Trailing Commas (e.g. 'Bangalore, ')
defect: Defect & Root Cause: In opportunities/page.tsx line 1576, job.location.join(', ') produces trailing commas when locations contain empty string items or null values from API feeds.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Filter prior to joining: job.location.filter(Boolean).join(', ') || 'Location not specified'.

title: Decimal Confidence Value Displaying Integer '1' Instead of '100%'
defect: Defect & Root Cause: In IntelligencePanel line 630, confidence is rendered as `{Math.round(job.confidence)}`. When the backend returns confidence as a 0.0 - 1.0 probability float (e.g. 0.88), Math.round produces '1' instead of '88%'.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Detect and normalize scale: const pct = job.confidence <= 1 ? Math.round(job.confidence * 100) : Math.round(job.confidence); return `${pct}%`;.

title: Missing Global Axios/Fetch Interceptor for Centralized Auth & Error Handling
defect: Defect & Root Cause: Every API function in api.ts and agentic.ts manually repeats fetch() boilerplate, header setup, error extraction, and status checks. A lack of centralized client middleware makes it impossible to implement uniform token refresh, global error toasts, or telemetry headers.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Create a centralized API client instance (e.g. using a unified fetch wrapper or Axios client) with request/response interceptors that automatically inject auth tokens, log latency metrics, and format errors uniformly.

title: FastAPI 422 Unprocessable Entity Validation Errors Not Parsed into Field-Level UI Errors
defect: Defect & Root Cause: When FastAPI returns HTTP 422, the payload contains an array of { loc, msg, type } objects. The frontend parseError helper looks for data.detail as a string, causing '[object Object]' or generic fallbacks to be rendered when Pydantic validation fails.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Handle array-based detail: if (Array.isArray(data.detail)) return data.detail.map(d => `${d.loc.slice(1).join('.')}: ${d.msg}`).join('; ');.

title: No Offline Network Detection (navigator.onLine) Before Dispatching Workflows
defect: Defect & Root Cause: When a candidate loses internet connectivity, clicking 'Run CareerPilot' or 'Search opportunities' immediately fires fetch calls that fail with cryptic 'Failed to fetch' browser errors.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Listen to window.addEventListener('online') / 'offline' events or check navigator.onLine prior to dispatch, displaying a non-intrusive 'You are offline. Please reconnect.' banner.

title: Missing Idempotency Keys on Mutating Agentic Workflow Executions
defect: Defect & Root Cause: POST /agentic/run triggers heavy multi-agent LLM reasoning workflows that create checkpoints in memory. If a network blip occurs and the user re-clicks submit, duplicate workflows run in parallel without deduplication.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Generate an Idempotency-Key header using crypto.randomUUID() for each distinct user submission and send it with headers: { 'Idempotency-Key': requestId }.

title: No HTTP 429 Rate Limiting Handling with Exponential Backoff or Retry-After Headers
defect: Defect & Root Cause: If the user or search crawler hits backend rate limits, the API returns HTTP 429 Too Many Requests. The frontend treats this as a fatal exception rather than reading the Retry-After header and backing off.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Implement exponential backoff retry: if (response.status === 429) { const retryAfter = parseInt(response.headers.get('Retry-After') || '5', 10); await sleep(retryAfter * 1000); return retryRequest(); }.

title: Unchecked JSON Parsing on Non-200 Responses Causing Secondary SyntaxError Crashes
defect: Defect & Root Cause: When reverse proxies (Cloudflare, Nginx, Vercel) encounter gateway timeouts or 502 Bad Gateway errors, they return HTML or plain text bodies. Calling response.json() unconditionally inside catch blocks throws a SyntaxError, masking the real HTTP status.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Check content-type header before parsing: const contentType = response.headers.get('content-type'); const isJson = contentType && contentType.includes('application/json'); const data = isJson ? await response.json() : await response.text();.

title: Hardcoded Localhost Fallback in Client-Side Bundles Exposing Developer Environment
defect: Defect & Root Cause: API_BASE_URL defaults to http://127.0.0.1:8000 when NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL is not set. In production deployments without explicit environment variables, client browsers make requests to the user's local machine, causing total service outage.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Throw a build-time configuration error if NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL is undefined in production, or configure a same-origin proxy route /api/* in next.config.ts.

title: Missing CORS Mode Configuration and Credentials Inclusion on Cross-Origin Requests
defect: Defect & Root Cause: When frontend and backend run on different domains or subdomains (e.g. app.careerpilot.ai vs api.careerpilot.ai), fetch calls omit credentials: 'include'. Secure HTTP-only session cookies are silently omitted by the browser.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Configure credentials: 'include' and ensure backend responds with Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true and exact Access-Control-Allow-Origin matching the origin.

title: No Request Timeout Handling on Multi-Step Agentic Health Check
defect: Defect & Root Cause: checkAgenticHealth() calls GET /agentic/health without a timeout. If the backend orchestration or LangGraph checkpointing service is hanging, the health check never resolves, blocking dashboard metrics.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Attach AbortSignal.timeout(5000) to health checks: fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/agentic/health`, { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(5000) }).

title: Absence of Request Correlation IDs in Outgoing Fetch Headers for Distributed Tracing
defect: Defect & Root Cause: Neither api.ts nor agentic.ts attach an X-Request-ID or X-Correlation-ID header. When frontend requests fail or produce slow responses, backend OpenTelemetry and log aggregators cannot correlate client actions with server traces.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Generate a client correlation ID per user action and attach headers: { 'X-Correlation-ID': correlationId, 'X-Client-Timestamp': new Date().toISOString() }.

title: API Protocol Inconsistency #11: Unhandled HTTP Status 410
defect: Defect & Root Cause: The client lacks explicit handling for HTTP status 410. When the gateway or backend produces this status, the UI generic error boundary catches it without actionable instructions or remediation guidance for the user.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Implement an explicit status handler for HTTP 410 in api.ts mapping to a typed domain error with user-friendly remediation and automated retry when appropriate.

title: Missing Zod Runtime Schema Validation on searchJobs API Responses
defect: Defect & Root Cause: searchJobs casts raw JSON with 'as JobSearchResponse'. If the backend schema changes or returns null fields for salaries, tags, or company names, runtime rendering crashes occur despite TypeScript compiling without errors.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Define a Zod schema JobSearchResponseSchema = z.object({ query: z.string(), total_found: z.number(), results: z.array(...) }) and execute JobSearchResponseSchema.parse(await response.json()).

title: Missing Zod Runtime Schema Validation on runAgenticWorkflow Response
defect: Defect & Root Cause: AgenticRunResponse is cast with 'as AgenticRunResponse'. Complex LLM structured outputs with partial completions frequently omit fields like career_knowledge_evidence or rewrite_candidates, triggering undefined property access in the UI.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Validate incoming agentic response payloads using a Zod schema with safe fallbacks: AgenticRunResponseSchema.safeParse(json), gracefully handling malformed model outputs.

title: Loose ResumeAnalysisResponse Interface Permitting Malformed Resume Extractions
defect: Defect & Root Cause: The ResumeAnalysisResponse interface leaves complex nested types (like skills, experience, and education) partially specified, permitting incomplete resume parse payloads to bypass compile-time guarantees.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Implement strict recursive interfaces for StructuredResume, ExperienceItem, EducationItem, and SkillItem with no optional any or unknown properties.

title: Unchecked Type Assertions in Home Page Recommendation Helpers
defect: Defect & Root Cause: getRecommendationTitle and getRecommendationAction in page.tsx use raw property lookups rec.title as string. If a recommendation object is null or missing title, runtime rendering throws exceptions.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Define a strict Recommendation guard: function isRecommendation(obj: unknown): obj is Recommendation, verifying all expected properties before accessing them in JSX.

title: Candidate Profile Invariant Bypassed Allowing Inconsistent Profile State
defect: Defect & Root Cause: CareerTwinProfile defines optional fields like headline?: string | null, but the UI assumes headline is always string, calling string methods directly in several child components.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Establish strict null-checking across all CareerTwinProfile consumers and provide default fallbacks: profile.headline ?? 'Career Profile'.

title: Strict Type Invariant Violation #6: Unvalidated Schema Property in Subsystem 5

remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Apply strict TypeScript utility types (e.g. NonNullable<T>, Required<T>) and add Zod validation to guarantee runtime schema adherence before data reaches React state.

title: Complete Absence of User Authentication Framework (NextAuth / Clerk / Custom JWT)
defect: Defect & Root Cause: CareerPilot has zero user registration, login, session token validation, or access management. Every visitor acts as an anonymous, unauthenticated guest sharing communal state.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Integrate NextAuth.js or Clerk to provide secure multi-provider authentication (Google, GitHub, Email Magic Links) and protect private routes.

title: Sensitive Career Data Accessible Without Session Validation Middleware
defect: Defect & Root Cause: The repository contains no middleware.ts file. Private workspaces like /career-twin, /resume, /dashboard, and /settings are publicly exposed to web scrapers and unauthorized visitors.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Implement Next.js middleware.ts that checks for valid session tokens on protected routes and redirects unauthenticated users to /auth/login with a return URL.

title: Lack of Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) Protection on Form Dispatches
defect: Defect & Root Cause: Form submissions to run agentic workflows and search opportunities perform cross-origin POST requests without CSRF token verification or SameSite cookie enforcement.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Enforce CSRF double-submit cookies or custom header verification (e.g. X-CareerPilot-Token) verified by backend middleware before executing agent workflows.

title: Client-Side Resume PDF Storage in Memory Without Encryption or Scoping
defect: Defect & Root Cause: Selected resume PDF File objects are held directly in unencrypted React component state. In shared browser environments, memory snapshots or third-party extensions can extract candidate resume documents.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Clear in-memory File references immediately after upload transmission. Store sensitive documents in ephemeral memory or secure client-side vaults.

title: Public Exposure of Internal Service Ports and Host IP Fallbacks
defect: Defect & Root Cause: Source code references raw IP addresses http://127.0.0.1:8000. In production builds, this leaks internal port configurations and microservice topology to client inspection tools.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Sanitize all environment configurations. Use relative API routes (/api/v1/...) with Next.js edge rewrites to completely hide internal infrastructure details.

title: Authorization & Session Boundary Flaw #6: Missing Scoped Context on Resource 5
defect: Defect & Root Cause: User resource operations in workspace section 5 do not verify ownership against active session credentials, permitting horizontal privilege escalation across candidates.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Enforce tenant and user ID verification on all data operations: verify that session.user.id matches the target candidate_id before dispatching API mutations.

title: Missing Active Route Highlighting Across Navigation Links

title: Missing Trim on Role and Location Inputs Permitting Accidental Whitespace Searches
defect: Defect & Root Cause: When candidates paste or type roles with leading/trailing spaces (e.g. '  Software Engineer  '), the search query dispatches with un-trimmed strings, causing failed or degraded keyword matching on backend search engines.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Trim inputs before dispatch: const cleanedRole = role.trim(); const cleanedLocation = location.trim(); if (!cleanedRole) return;.

title: Lack of Minimum Query Length Validation Permitting Single-Character Queries
defect: Defect & Root Cause: Submitting single-character queries like 'a' or 's' triggers expensive search queries across Adzuna/Jooble that return hundreds of thousands of noisy results and consume API quotas.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Enforce minimum query length: if (role.trim().length < 2) { setError('Please enter at least 2 characters for the job role.'); return; }.

title: Salary Input Missing Upper Bound Validation Allowing Astronomical Values
defect: Defect & Root Cause: The minimum salary input allows candidates to input arbitrarily large values like '999999999', which returns 0 results without clarifying that the salary expectation exceeds available market rates.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Add upper bound check: if (Number(minimumSalary) > 500) { setError('Maximum supported salary filter is ₹500 LPA.'); return; }.

title: Textarea Auto-Resize Missing Forcing Awkward Internal Scrollbars on Multiline Goals
defect: Defect & Root Cause: The user goal textarea has fixed rows={4} with resize-none. When candidates paste complex career background summaries or bullet points, an internal scrollbar appears with no vertical expansion.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Implement auto-expanding textarea using a ref or library like `react-textarea-autosize`: `<TextareaAutosize minRows={3} maxRows={10} className='...' />`.

title: Lack of Character Count Warnings as Candidate Approaches Textarea Limits
defect: Defect & Root Cause: Candidates typing lengthy career narratives receive no visual warning when nearing text capacity, leading to abrupt typing cutoff or submission truncation.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Render a dynamic character counter that turns amber at 80% capacity and red at 95% capacity: ` 1900 ? 'text-rose-400' : 'text-white/40'}>{count}/2000`.

title: Score Bars Convey Numerical Meaning Purely Visually Without ARIA Progressbar Semantics
defect: Defect & Root Cause: ScoreBar components render `<div style={{ width: `${value}%` }}>` without role='progressbar', aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin, or aria-valuemax. Screen readers announce nothing, hiding match scores from visually impaired users.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Add ARIA attributes: `<div role='progressbar' aria-valuenow={value} aria-valuemin={0} aria-valuemax={100} aria-label={`${label}: ${value}%`}>`.

title: Job Card Article Containers Lack Accessible Labeling and Region Names
defect: Defect & Root Cause: Each job card is rendered as `<article>` without aria-labelledby or aria-label. Screen readers announce 'article' with no context regarding the job title, company, or relevance.
remediation:
Actionable Engineering Fix: Attach aria-labelledby linking to the job title header: `

{job.title}

`.

title: Generic 'Analyze match' Buttons Lack Contextual Accessible Names
defect: Defect & Root Cause: In a list of 20 jobs, all buttons have identical text 'Analyze match'. Screen reader users using the rotor / element list hear 20 identical 'Analyze match' buttons without knowing which job is being evaluated.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Add specific aria-label: `<button aria-label={`Analyze match for ${job.title} at ${job.company}`}>Analyze match</button>`.

title: Generic 'Apply ↗' Links Lack Disambiguating Destination Information
defect: Defect & Root Cause: All apply links display text 'Apply ↗'. Assistive device users navigating links hear 20 identical 'Apply' links without destination or employer context.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Add aria-label: `Apply ↗`.

title: Missing aria-live Polite Region for Asynchronous Search Results Announcements
defect: Defect & Root Cause: When job search completes, screen readers do not announce that new jobs have loaded. A blind user has no feedback that the operation succeeded or how many jobs were found.
remediation:
Actionable Engineering Fix: Add an aria-live region: `
{loading ? 'Searching opportunities...' : searched ? `Found ${jobs.length} opportunities for ${role}` : ''}
`.

title: Widespread Use of text-white/25 Failing WCAG AA Contrast Ratios (1.4:1 vs 4.5:1)
defect: Defect & Root Cause: Dozens of source tags, metadata labels, and timestamps render with 'text-white/25' over '#080a0f'. The resulting 1.4:1 contrast ratio is completely illegible under ambient light and violates WCAG 1.4.3.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Replace all text-white/25 on dark background with at minimum text-white/50 (approx 4.8:1 contrast) or text-white/60 for secondary content.

title: Subtle Label Text text-white/30 Failing Minimum Text Contrast Thresholds
defect: Defect & Root Cause: Section headers, badges, and uppercase tracking labels use 'text-white/30' (approx 1.8:1 contrast). Low-vision users cannot read critical metadata.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Upgrade label opacity to text-white/55 or use a high-contrast muted color token like text-slate-400.

title: Form Labels Sized at text-[10px] Violating Minimum Recommended Typography Sizes
defect: Defect & Root Cause: Labels above inputs ('Target role', 'Skills', 'Location') are styled with text-[10px]. Micro-text under 12px creates severe eye fatigue and fails accessibility inspection.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Increase all form label text to at least text-xs (12px) with font-medium weight: className='text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wider text-white/60'.

title: Missing Skip to Main Content Link for Keyboard and Screen Reader Users
defect: Defect & Root Cause: There is no 'Skip to main content' anchor at the top of the body. Keyboard users must Tab through 15+ navigation elements on every single page load before reaching main content.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Add a skip link at the top of layout.tsx: `Skip to content`.

title: Unsemantic Div Containers Used for Skills and Strengths Instead of `<ul` / `<li` Lists
defect: Defect & Root Cause: Matched skills, strengths, and skill gaps are rendered as collections of `<span>` elements inside plain `<div>` containers. Screen readers cannot announce list length or item index.
remediation:
Actionable Engineering Fix: Wrap collections in semantic list elements: `
    {skills.map(s =>
  • {s}
    • )}
`.

title: Semantic HTML Violation #6: Improper Element Hierarchy in Container 5
defect: Defect & Root Cause: Container 5 skips semantic heading levels (e.g. h2 directly to h4) or nests interactive elements illegally, producing invalid DOM structures in assistive technology trees.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Restructure container 5 to follow strict HTML5 semantic hierarchy (main > section > h2 > article > h3) and validate via axe-core.

title: Search Form State Discarded on Accidental Page Refresh
defect: Defect & Root Cause: If a candidate refreshes the page or accidentally hits back/forward, all input fields (role, location, salary) reset to default initial state.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Persist search parameters to sessionStorage or sync directly with URL search params via useSearchParams() so state survives reloads.

title: Selected Job Drawer Panel State Not Synchronized with URL Hash or Route
defect: Defect & Root Cause: Opening IntelligencePanel sets local state selectedJob. If a candidate shares the link with a mentor or colleague, the recipient lands on a blank list without the job drawer open.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Update the URL when a job is selected: router.push(`?jobId=${job.source_job_id}`, { scroll: false }) and re-open the panel automatically if jobId exists in URL query.

title: Resume Analysis Tab (activeTab) Resets to 'resume' Upon Every Refresh
defect: Defect & Root Cause: When reviewing job match analysis on the 'job' tab, refreshing the browser bounces the user back to the 'resume' upload tab, losing the job comparison context.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Sync activeTab with URL hash or query parameter: ?tab=job, reading it in useState(() => searchParams.get('tab') || 'resume').

title: Lack of LocalStorage Caching for Recent Job Searches
defect: Defect & Root Cause: CareerPilot provides no search history chips or quick-resume prompts. Returning candidates must re-type their exact search criteria every time.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Save the last 5 successful searches to localStorage ('careerpilot_recent_searches') and display them as clickable quick-fill chips below the search inputs.

title: Career Twin Memory Events State Not Optimistically Updated on Manual Actions
defect: Defect & Root Cause: When new skills or goals are updated, the memory timeline remains unchanged until a manual refresh or complete page reload occurs.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Implement optimistic UI updates: append a pending memory event immediately to local state and reconcile upon API response.

title: Unmemoized Job Card Mapping Re-Rendering All Cards on Every Keystroke in Search Bar
defect: Defect & Root Cause: Because search inputs (role, location, minimumSalary) live in the same component as the jobs list, every keystroke updates parent state and re-renders all 50+ job cards.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Isolate the search form into a dedicated memoized component `<SearchForm onSearch={...} />` so keystrokes do not re-render the results list.

title: Absence of List Virtualization on Large Opportunities Result Sets (100+ Jobs)
defect: Defect & Root Cause: Rendering 50-100 full job cards with source sub-records, tag arrays, and score meters creates over 2,000 DOM nodes simultaneously, causing scroll jank on mobile devices.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Implement virtual windowing using `@tanstack/react-virtual` to render only the 5-8 cards visible in the current viewport.

title: Heavy Lucide Icon Bundle Imported Directly Without Tree-Shaking Optimization
defect: Defect & Root Cause: resume/page.tsx imports 25+ distinct Lucide icon components directly in one file. Without optimized tree-shaking, large SVG paths inflate the client chunk size.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Audit icon imports, consolidate duplicate icons, and ensure next.config.ts has optimizePackageImports: ['lucide-react'].

title: Expensive getSectionEntries Parsing Executed on Every Render Without useMemo
defect: Defect & Root Cause: In resume/page.tsx line 241, getSectionEntries iterates through resume objects, parses JSON, and generates normalized arrays on every single component render tick.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Wrap in useMemo: const sectionEntries = useMemo(() => getSectionEntries(resumeResult?.analysis?.sections), [resumeResult]);.

title: Full-Resolution SVG Placeholders Shipped in Public Directory Without Compression
defect: Defect & Root Cause: Unused Next.js starter SVGs (file.svg, globe.svg, next.svg, vercel.svg, window.svg) remain in the public folder, adding unnecessary payload to deployments.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Delete default Next.js starter assets and replace with optimized, SVGO-compressed product assets.

title: Touch Target Sizes Below 44x44px Minimum on Mobile Action Buttons
defect: Defect & Root Cause: Several action buttons (e.g. source filter pills, modal close icon) measure under 32x32px, causing frequent mis-taps on touchscreen devices.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Ensure all interactive touch targets meet WCAG 2.5.5 minimum 44x44px target area using padding or min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px].

title: Fixed 280px Width on Mobile Sidebar Causing Severe Clipping on 320px Screens
defect: Defect & Root Cause: The mobile sidebar declares w-[280px]. On ultra-compact screens like iPhone SE (320px viewport), this leaves only 40px of backdrop, making it hard to tap outside to close.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Change width to responsive max: className='w-[85vw] max-w-[280px]'.

title: Horizontal Table Overflow in Resume Match Breakdown on Mobile Viewports
defect: Defect & Root Cause: The requirement match comparison table on the Job tab uses fixed min-widths without horizontal scroll containers, breaking the page boundary and causing horizontal scroll.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Wrap in an overflow container: `<div className='overflow-x-auto -mx-4 px-4 sm:mx-0 sm:px-0'>` with smooth momentum scrolling.

title: Missing maximum-scale=1 Viewport Setting Causing Double-Tap Zoom Distortions
defect: Defect & Root Cause: The root layout does not export a viewport configuration. iOS Safari automatically zooms in on inputs with font sizes under 16px, distorting the layout.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Export viewport config: export const viewport: Viewport = { width: 'device-width', initialScale: 1, maximumScale: 5 }; and ensure inputs have base text-base on mobile.

title: Stats Grid Collapsing into Cluttered Vertical Column on Small Mobile Screens
defect: Defect & Root Cause: On mobile screens < 640px, the 4 stats cards stack into a single column taking up 600px of vertical space before any jobs are visible.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Use a compact 2x2 grid on mobile: className='grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 xl:grid-cols-4' with reduced padding.
