title: Hardcoded Unicode Symbols ('✓', '△', '↗') Mixed Inconsistently with Lucide SVGs
defect: Defect & Root Cause: Strengths use literal Unicode '✓', skill gaps use Unicode triangle '△', and external links use '↗'. Across the same page, Lucide Check and ExternalLink SVG icons are also used, creating jarring visual font-family and optical weight differences.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Standardize exclusively on Lucide icons: replace '✓' with `<Check size={12} className='text-emerald-400' />`, '△' with `<AlertTriangle size={12} className='text-amber-400' />`, and '↗' with `<ExternalLink size={12} />`.

title: Literal Curly Quotes Rendered as Disjointed Text Nodes Around Salary Evidence

{source.salary_evidence}

title: Raw Millisecond Timestamps Rendered in Memory Events Without Relative Time Formatting
defect: Defect & Root Cause: formatDate outputs absolute dates like 'Sep 28, 2026, 11:04 PM'. Candidates cannot quickly tell if an event occurred 5 minutes ago or last month.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Implement relative time formatting using date-fns or native Intl.RelativeTimeFormat (e.g. '2 hours ago', 'Yesterday').

title: Arbitrary Letter Spacing (tracking-[0.16em], tracking-[0.18em], tracking-[0.2em]) Proliferation
defect: Defect & Root Cause: Micro-labels define tracking-[0.16em], tracking-[0.17em], tracking-[0.18em], and tracking-[0.2em] with zero systemic logic, bloating generated CSS classes.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Consolidate into Tailwind standard tokens tracking-wider (0.05em) and tracking-widest (0.1em), or define a single custom token 'tracking-caps' in tailwind.config.ts.

title: Hardcoded Currency Formatting Ignoring International Exchange and Locale Norms
defect: Defect & Root Cause: Salaries are hardcoded with '₹' and 'LPA'. When international job boards return USD ($) or GBP (£) compensation, the currency prefix displays incorrectly as '₹$120,000 LPA'.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Detect source currency code and format dynamically: new Intl.NumberFormat('en-IN', { style: 'currency', currency: job.currency || 'INR' }).format(salary).

title: IntelligencePanel Lacks Keyboard Shortcuts to Navigate Between Previous / Next Jobs
defect: Defect & Root Cause: Candidates reviewing multiple matched roles must repeatedly close the panel, scroll the list, and click another card. There are no Next / Previous arrow buttons.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Add Next (`J` / `ArrowRight`) and Previous (`K` / `ArrowLeft`) keyboard hotkeys and header navigation chevrons to cycle through matched jobs.

title: Candidate Position Indicator Missing in IntelligencePanel Header (e.g. 'Job 3 of 15')
defect: Defect & Root Cause: The drawer provides no context on where the active opportunity sits within the overall search ranking.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Add a position pill in the drawer header: `Opportunity {currentIndex + 1} of {jobs.length}`.

title: Match Score Breakdown Bars Monochromatically White Instead of Color-Coded by Tier
defect: Defect & Root Cause: All sub-score bars (Skills, Seniority, Location, Salary) in the drawer render in plain white fill regardless of score.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Color-code score bars: emerald (80+), cyan (70+), amber (50+), rose (<50).

title: Source Records Missing Posted Date Relative Timestamp Display
defect: Defect & Root Cause: Underlying job board source cards omit the posted_at timestamp. Candidates cannot tell if a listing is fresh (posted today) or stale (posted 60 days ago).
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Format and display posted_at: `Posted {formatRelativeDate(source.posted_at)}`.

title: Job Match Decision 'LOW_PRIORITY' Renders Default Gray Instead of Meaningful Styling
defect: Defect & Root Cause: getDecisionClass has cases for APPLY_NOW, GOOD_MATCH, and STRETCH, but omits LOW_PRIORITY, falling back to neutral white/gray styling.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Add explicit case: case 'LOW_PRIORITY': return 'border-slate-500/20 bg-slate-500/10 text-slate-300';.

title: Zero Unit Test Coverage Across All Critical Formatting and Parsing Functions
defect: Defect & Root Cause: Critical utilities like formatSalary, formatDecision, clampScore, and parseError have zero automated unit test coverage. Any refactor risks silently breaking salary display and score metrics.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Set up Vitest: write unit test suites in tests/formatters.test.ts testing nulls, negative numbers, extreme currency ranges, and missing fields.

title: Absence of End-to-End (E2E) Browser Test Harness (Playwright / Cypress)
defect: Defect & Root Cause: The frontend has no automated browser test suite. Core user journeys—such as running an agentic goal workflow, uploading a resume PDF, and filtering opportunities—are never validated on commit.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Install and configure Playwright: npm install -D @playwright/test, creating smoke tests in e2e/search.spec.ts and e2e/resume.spec.ts covering happy and failure paths.

title: No Mock Service Worker (MSW) or API Contract Testing Harness for Local Development
defect: Defect & Root Cause: Frontend developers cannot work offline or test edge-case error states (e.g. 504 Gateway Timeout, partial LLM streams) without running the full Python backend and live external aggregators.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Implement Mock Service Worker (msw) with request handlers mocking /agentic/run, /jobs/search, and /career-twin, enabling deterministic local UI development.

title: Missing Component Test Suite for IntelligencePanel Drawer and Modal Transitions
defect: Defect & Root Cause: The complex IntelligencePanel drawer has no component tests verifying that clicking close triggers onClose, that escape keys dismiss, or that score bars render corresponding widths.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Write React Testing Library test in components/IntelligencePanel.test.tsx using user-event to assert focus trapping, keyboard dismissal, and data rendering.

title: Missing output: 'standalone' in next.config.ts for Optimized Docker Containerization
defect: Defect & Root Cause: Without output: 'standalone', Docker production images must bundle entire node_modules folders, resulting in multi-gigabyte image sizes and slow cold-start deployment times.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Configure output: 'standalone' in next.config.ts, leveraging Next.js automated trace-based asset pruning for lightweight container builds under 150MB.

title: Absence of Webpack / Turbopack Bundle Analyzer to Guard Against Size Regressions
defect: Defect & Root Cause: The project lacks @next/bundle-analyzer. Unintended imports (e.g. heavy parsing libraries or duplicate icons) can inflate bundle sizes unnoticed.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Install @next/bundle-analyzer and wrap nextConfig with withBundleAnalyzer({ enabled: process.env.ANALYZE === 'true' }).

title: Missing Git Pre-Commit Hooks (Husky + lint-staged) Enforcing Hygiene on Commit
defect: Defect & Root Cause: Developers can commit unformatted code, lint errors, and broken TypeScript types directly into the git repository without automated pre-commit barriers.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Install husky and lint-staged: configure pre-commit to run 'next lint --fix' and 'tsc --noEmit' on staged files prior to commit creation.

title: No GitHub Actions CI Workflow for Automated Build and Typecheck Validation
defect: Defect & Root Cause: There is no GitHub Actions workflow verifying that pull requests compile cleanly. Broken code can be merged directly into main.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Create .github/workflows/ci.yml executing npm ci, npm run lint, npm run typecheck, and npm run build on all push and pull_request events.

title: Hardcoded Indian Rupee (₹) Symbol Rendering Across Global Job Results
defect: Defect & Root Cause: Salaries are formatted with hardcoded '₹' prefix. If an international candidate searches for remote roles paying in USD or Euros, results display corrupt strings like '₹$140,000'.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Dynamically resolve currency code from source metadata or user preferences using Intl.NumberFormat(locale, { style: 'currency', currency }).

title: Complete Absence of Internationalization Framework (next-intl / react-i18next)
defect: Defect & Root Cause: All UI strings, badges, button labels, and error messages are hardcoded English strings. Expanding CareerPilot to multi-lingual Indian or global markets is impossible without massive code refactors.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Set up `next-intl` with dictionary JSON files (en.json, hi.json) and locale-aware routing (/en/opportunities, /hi/opportunities).

title: Date Formatting Disregarding Candidate Timezone and Regional Calendar Conventions
defect: Defect & Root Cause: Intl.DateTimeFormat hardcodes 'en-IN'. Users in other timezones or regions see dates formatted in unfamiliar month/day orders and Indian Standard Time offsets.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Omit hardcoded locale to inherit the browser user's native locale, or pass candidate preferences stored in their user settings.

title: No Support for Right-to-Left (RTL) Layout Directionality or Bi-Directional Text
defect: Defect & Root Cause: The root html element hardcodes dir='ltr'. Bidirectional text (e.g. Urdu, Arabic, Hebrew) breaks alignment and layout symmetry.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Configure dynamic dir={getDirection(locale)} on the html tag and utilize Tailwind logical utilities (ps-, pe-, ms-, me- instead of pl-, pr-, ml-, mr-).

title: Total Absence of Client-Side Exception Monitoring and Error Crash Tracking (Sentry / Datadog)
defect: Defect & Root Cause: When unhandled exceptions occur in production (such as null pointer dereferences or network dropped frames), developers have zero telemetry or alerts. Bugs remain invisible until users complain.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Integrate @sentry/nextjs: configure sentry.client.config.ts and Sentry error boundaries to capture client-side stack traces with breadcrumbs.

title: Console.log Statements and Debug Traces Leaking into Production Bundles
defect: Defect & Root Cause: Various debugging console.log/console.error calls are executed in production builds, cluttering developer tools and leaking internal state.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Configure Babel/SWC transform to strip console.log in production builds: compiler: { removeConsole: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production' ? { exclude: ['error', 'warn'] } : false } in next.config.ts.

title: Missing Web Vitals Real User Monitoring (RUM) Tracking (LCP, FID, CLS, INP)
defect: Defect & Root Cause: There is no tracking of Core Web Vitals. Degraded Largest Contentful Paint or Interaction to Next Paint regressions go unnoticed.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Implement useReportWebVitals hook: export function reportWebVitals(metric: NextWebVitalsMetric) { sendToAnalytics(metric); }.

title: No Health Check Endpoint (/api/health) on Next.js Frontend for Load Balancer Probes
defect: Defect & Root Cause: Kubernetes or cloud load balancers cannot probe the health of the Next.js Node container without loading full React pages, creating unnecessary compute load.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Create a lightweight Route Handler app/api/health/route.ts returning Response.json({ status: 'healthy', uptime: process.uptime() }, { status: 200 }).

title: Missing Progressive Web App (PWA) Manifest and Offline Service Worker
defect: Defect & Root Cause: CareerPilot cannot be installed as a progressive web app on iOS or Android, and exhibits zero offline resilience when mobile users enter connectivity dead zones.
remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Add app/manifest.ts defining app name, standalone display mode, theme colors, and icons; configure next-pwa for offline caching.

remediation: Actionable Engineering Fix: Implement automated metric tracking and health threshold checks for signal 5 with notification hooks to Slack / PagerDuty.
